title: Q-LESSON-no-template-leaks: enforce the lesson in code
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** lesson `no-template-leaks` in doctrine/lessons.json has no enforcing code
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation lessons --check
**Status:** open

LESSONS-1: add a check that fails when a live page or generated module contains seed placeholders such as {org_name}. Then add the binding to the lesson in doctrine/lessons.json and close this item.

**Prediction:** template_leaks <= 0 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** rewriting seed templates that are meant to hold placeholders.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation lessons --report` lists `no-template-leaks` as enforced.
